pages.title: Holder
pages.text: The Holder is a commonly found critter near Risus structures. They are small and relatively harmless but they come with their own risks. If they aren't holding an object, they will seek out a person and steal the item in their hand, then proceed to run away with it. Hitting the Holder will result in them dropping the held item. They can be destroyed for a piece or two of $(l:materials/organic_matter)$(c)$(o)Organic Matter$() and their $(l:tools/hand_of_greed)$(c)$(o)hand$().
They may be small and not really lethal, but such traits lead to easily underestimating them...

On top of enjoying the thrill of stealing, Holders also enjoy being kidnapped. If they aren't holding any items, they can be picked up with an Empty Bucket without much issue, and won't even try getting out. Additionally, they generally don't target those holding Empty Buckets.
